mathematics.assertion_tested: Efficient balanced search uses exact cached integer cuts, correct incremental swap deltas and vectorized cross-pair scans; compact completed-checkpoint prefixes reconstruct valid cuts and cannot credit a late batch. Fixed-count trajectories reproduce from seeds, including carried-priority relabeling.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Bounded NumPy int64 graph/cut/delta arithmetic; independent Python integer edge sums; float64 temperatures and monotone clock observations
mathematics.conventions: Graph N6/N10 fixtures are newly generated test inputs, not DEV graphs or held-out graphs. No optimum is computed or input. Given-free common incumbent is verified. CPU/wall include validation, setup, search and compact traces, exclude JSON conversion and disk writes. Proposal cap is not a resource-equivalence assertion; early cap/wall stop prevents accepting a positive.
inputs: All balanced subsets and all cross-swaps of fixed seeded N6/N10 integer test graphs, checked against independent scalar edge sums
100-swap sequences per N6/N10, fixed-count repeated searches, carried-priority relabeling and all compact trace cuts
Synthetic/virtual-clock deadline-prefix checks; invalid graph/source/Cref/overflow cases; zero-weight N2/N6 boundaries
non_claims: No DEV or confirmation graph generated or searched
No new photonic result, positive advantage or QPU validation
No optimality guarantee for the classical heuristic
No speed claim from test elapsed time or score-unit resource equivalence
No change to any prior pilot/helper/raw archive/manuscript

randomness.generator: NumPy default_rng/PCG64, fixed-count trajectories independent of clock
randomness.graph_population_selection: N6/N10 predetermined fixture seeds; all balanced states retained, no favorable instance selection

checks.check: process exited successfully within enforced limits
declared result files are present and regular

result: Run completed; mathematical assertion requires interpretation and review.
residual_risks: Command success does not establish the mathematical interpretation.
Only listed input artifacts are pinned; external dependencies need recorded versions.
The thread cap uses conventional environment variables; a child program may ignore them.
The POSIX CPU-time limit is per process, not an aggregate descendant budget.
